SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. 176 No.
8. 11. 31
Station,
REPORT
Date December 17, 1930.
Subject (in full) Report on attached complaint.
Made by D. I. Mason, Forwarded by [Signature] C.I.
Sir,
I beg to report having visited the Kyung Dai Lodging House, 94, Foochow Road together with C. D. S. I. Ziu Sz Dzien on the 13th inst.
Enquiries show that the women complained of left the premises that morning. Her destination is believed to be Chin-kiang. The books of the lodging house show that she has stayed there on three occasions recently, and on each occasion occupied a different room, and was visited by C. D. S. 62 Wong Kyung Sung.
On November 7th she took room No. 59 and left the same day; Between November 10th and 20th she occupied room No. 54 and from December 5th to 13th room No. 58. The bills in connection with the above amount to $36.40, of which only $13.00 has been paid. This was paid by the woman when she left on the 13-12-30 a chit being signed by her for the balance, payment of this being guaranteed by C. D. S. 62 verbally.
The accountant states he does not know who wrote the letter but suspects it was written by a guest who was disturbed. He further states that the woman was very noisy and abusive during her stays there. Crockery was only broken on one occasion. This was on the 10th inst. when the woman, whose name is given as Lee Loh Thing ( ), sent a coolie named Tsung Hwei ( ) to pawn some clothing. On his return he asked if he should deduct some of the amount owing, from the pawn money. The woman thereupon kicked him and threw a teapot and two cups at him. He suffered no injury and does not wish to take any action in the matter. The accountant of the Hotel states that he has no complaint to make regarding C. D. S. 62 stating that he has always behaved himself properly when visiting the hotel. The C. D. S. 62 states that the woman is

日期：1930年12月17日。
主题（全称）：关于所附投诉的报告。
呈报人：D. I. Mason，转呈人：[签名] C.I.
先生，
谨此报告，本人于本月13日会同华籍侦探副巡长 Ziu Sz Dzien 前往福州路94号京大旅馆（Kyung Dai Lodging House）查访。
经查，被投诉之女子已于当日上午离开该处。据信其去向为镇江。旅馆账册显示，她近期曾三次入住，每次均居住不同房间，且均由华籍侦探第62号 Wong Kyung Sung 探访。
11月7日，她入住59号房，并于同日离开；11月10日至20日期间，她入住54号房；12月5日至13日，她入住58号房。上述费用共计36.40元，其中仅支付13.00元。该款项系该女子于1930年12月13日离开时支付，余款由其签署欠条，并由华籍侦探第62号口头担保支付。
会计师表示，不知信件由何人所写，但怀疑是由一名受扰的客人所写。他还表示，该女子在住宿期间非常吵闹且满口脏话。餐具仅在一种情况下被打破。那是本月10日，该名自称 Lee Loh Thing（音译）的女子派一名名叫 Tsung Hwei（音译）的苦力去典当一些衣物。苦力回来后询问是否应从典当中扣除部分欠款。该女子随即踢了他，并向他扔去一把茶壶和两只茶杯。苦力未受伤，也不愿就此采取任何行动。旅馆会计师表示，他对华籍侦探第62号并无不满，称其在探访旅馆时行为一直端正。华籍侦探第62号称，该女子是
（左侧批注：警务处 / R. C. du / 2 / 答复）

the sweetheart of a man named Lee Dau Chih (      ) who at present
is at Nanking on a business trip. He further states that this man
requested him to assist the woman financially in his absence.
This statement does not appear to be correct.
He has been instructed to settle the debt immediately.
The licensee has been interviewed. He states that he is
not the writer of the letter and is of the opinion that it was
written by a guest who was disturbed by the woman. He corroborat-
es the statement of the accountant regarding the good behaviour of
C. D. S. 62 at the Hotel and does not wish to take any action in
the matter.
It is known that C. D. S. 62 is not on good terms with
several Chinese members of the Crime Branch at this Station and it
is possible that the letter was written by them or at their insti-
gation.
In order to prevent further trouble I respectfully
suggest that C. D. S. 62 be transferred to another District.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
Mason.

一名名叫 Lee Dau Chih（音译）的男子的女友，该男子目前因公出差在南京。他还称，该男子请求他在其不在期间给予该女子经济资助。
此说法似乎不实。
已指令其立即清偿债务。
已与执照持有人面谈。他表示自己并非写信人，并认为信件是由一名受该女子打扰的客人所写。他证实了会计师关于华籍侦探第62号在旅馆行为良好的说法，并表示不愿就此采取任何行动。
据悉，华籍侦探第62号与本分局刑事科几名华籍成员关系不和，信件有可能是由他们或其唆使下所写。
为防止进一步麻烦，卑职建议将华籍侦探第62号调往其他辖区。
先生，
您忠顺的仆人，
Mason.

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
（印：...POLICE ...nony 9199/142 ...12/12/30...）

Translation of Anonymous Letter from Kyung Dei Lodgin_ House, Foochow Road.

December 10, 1930.

To
The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Sir,
Whilst appreciating your fair treatment accorded to business men in the Settlement, since you were appointed as the Commissioner of Police, I take the liberty of informing you that I have recently owned a small lodging house - Kyung Dei Lodging House on Foochow Road near Shanbung Road, and reporting that Wong Ayun, Sung, C.D.S. attached to the Central Station together with his sweetheart have engaged a room No. 18 at this lodging house, the latter assuming a fictitious name as Miss Lee. Ever since her admittance, good order and peace could scarcely be maintained here, inasmuch as she taking the advantage of the official position and influence of C.D.S. Wong, sings every night and day on top of her voice. Our patrons neighbouring to her room have complained to us that they could not sleep, because of her disturbance. A garcon who appealed to her to discontinue the nuisance was kicked at and punched by her. Besides, wash basins and tea-cups etc. have been used as missiles to throw at him by this lady. When same was reported to the said C.D.S., he instead of righting the wrong further abused the staff

总办办公室。
（印：...POLICE ...nony 9199/142 ...1930年12月12日...）

福州路京大旅馆匿名信译文。

1930年12月10日。

致
上海公共租界工部局警务处
总办先生。

先生，
自从您担任警务处总办以来，鉴于您对租界内商人公正对待，卑职冒昧告知，本人最近在靠近山北路（Shanbung Road）的福州路拥有一家小旅馆——京大旅馆（Kyung Dei Lodging House），并报告称，隶属中央分局的华籍侦探 Wong Ayun, Sung（即 Wong Kyung Sung）与其女友在本旅馆包租了18号房间，后者化名李小姐。自她入住以来，此处难以维持秩序与安宁，因为她仗着华籍侦探 Wong 的官方职位和影响力，日夜高声歌唱。邻近她房间的客人向我们投诉，因受其干扰无法入睡。一名侍者劝其停止滋扰，竟被她踢打拳击。此外，这位女士还将脸盆、茶杯等物当作投掷武器砸向他。当此事向该华籍侦探报告时，他非但不纠正错误，反而辱骂员工

pages.en:
and threatened to suspend our Licence and withhold
payment of the hotel bill.
It is absurd that he should have behaved so
detestably and provokingly that neither we nor our
patrons could stand any longer of it. We would have
presented the case before the Streets Union, were he
not a member of your Force, which will concern your
good reputation.
When you are good enough to cause enquiries to
be made into the above, please do not disclose the
writer of this letter to the detective, whom you might
send for this duty, lest he should take revenge upon
us. If you should investigate the matter yourself,
kindly come directly to the first floor of this lodg-
ing house, where the smashed tea-pots etc. could still
be produced there.
In fact we would rather sacrifice his rent, if
they would leave here, although we are here not to
lose business if we could help it.
Excuse me for not having signed my name here-
under.
(Sgn.): The Staff of Chung Sai Lodging House

并威胁要吊销我们的执照并拒付旅馆账单。
他的行为如此可恶且具挑衅性，以致我们和客人都再也无法忍受，这真是荒谬。若非他是贵处人员，关乎您的良好声誉，我们本会将此事提交至马路商会（Streets Union）。
当您惠予调查上述情况时，请勿向您可能派来执行此任务的侦探透露写信人身份，以免他对我们进行报复。若您亲自调查，请直接来到本旅馆一楼，那里仍可出示被打碎的茶壶等物证。
事实上，只要他们离开这里，我们宁愿放弃其租金，尽管若能避免，我们并不想失去生意。
恕卑职在此未署名。
（签名）：众赛旅馆（Chung Sai Lodging House）全体员工
